events.title: Bohemian Dreams
events.description: An evening of live performance featuring eclectic and bohemian-inspired music, hosted in a central city venue. This performance-based event offers an intimate artistic experience suitable for those interested in live culture.

events.title: Open day onboard STS Young Endeavour
events.description: An opportunity to board the STS Young Endeavour, a sail training ship, to explore its construction, history, and the seafaring lifestyle. This is a chance for those interested in history and maritime engineering to engage with the vessel up close.

events.title: Ukrainian Festival Brisbane 2026
events.description: A celebration of Ukrainian culture through traditional music, art, and dance, offering an immersive look into heritage and community traditions. Ideal for those interested in cultural anthropology and diverse artistic expressions.
